protocol.initialization: Stage 3 deterministic initialization procedure, same seed 2028 and PyTorch version; never pretrained weights
protocol.selection_rule: Across epochs and C lambdas: lowest validation final-t=1 AR relative L2, then mass error, then earliest epoch, then smaller lambda on exact ties.
protocol.evaluation_firewall: No Stage 4 results or OOD archive are read by this training script.
